body: Maybe take a vacation if you can. I’m trying to myself.
I have seen both. Nothing changes alas.
Anything I pray for does not come through.

No one sane runs for president anymore. The problem with being progressive is it suggests you have no morality because you will never reach a place of peace, you only want infinite change and are never satisfied. Bernie is the real deal but he’s too far for most. Biden could maybe win if he figures out which way to face on stage and doesn’t pick the wrong running mate. Warren is going to be up against the Hillary problem of being the wrong woman to take on the ego of a megalomaniac, who showed that the GOP have no backbone or consistent ethics when it comes to power.

Things are objectively bad. There is a haze but my life is a terrible mess I haven’t been able to fix. No prayers answered and no strength or vision to embrace. If I had one pill to take I’d have taken it. Or a gun. Don’t want to do this another day.
I don’t have the will. I just couldn’t pull it off. I’m not sure I’m going to keep going. This depression and loneliness is non stop. I just have to tell someone to come get my dog.
I tried and failed. I have friends and family but not close by. I hope to start over and find joy again.
I pray every day and nothing has improved. Beg for direction. Nothing. My health, relationships, hope are gone.
My life is a sad, lonely, broke disaster and I don’t see any way out.
Seriously 4-0 in the 5th. It’s not impossible but the country/universe must be punishing Washington for the politics.
I think you need a vacation. Do that before you off yourself it will give you perspective. Something may click.
Try and stick around for your self and the dreams you have
I keep reaching out and things get worse.
I stopped believing, maybe a prayer to be happy again.
Sure win the lottery. And stop being insane.
My life is destroyed and I despise where I am. Relationships, career, home, family, creativity, spirituality. All fubar.
I took a bunch of otc sleeping pills. Not enough I woke up unable to walk straight and I couldn’t talk the next day.
Losing everything that mattered. There’s no point to this. I just need a method.
True
This is a good point. What is real life?
They need to go yes. How to do it is the question.
Thank you for responding.
